about: Every input, model and result the paper relies on: where it lives, its checksum, and the exact command that makes it. Commands run from the repo root (baselines: from baselines/). 'code' is the git commit that produced the item. Checked by scripts/check_submission.py; explained in SUBMISSION.md.

data.where: Google Drive: Foundation Model(Mainak Sir)/preproccesed -> data/preprocessed/ (not in git: too large). Raw inputs: Drive yearly_data.zip and ERA 5/; pipeline code in data_pipeline/. v2: data/delhi/ is built from the same raw inputs by the data_pipeline commands in docs/V2_PROGRESS.md (step 2); not on Drive. data/mumbai/ is built (in under a second) from the Mumbai Drive array mumbai_all_data_2324_28locs.npy (sha256 bb355573037d4db77bc08d7a603cccb05c06db31d2974fdbc960e694ba9e3330) by: python data_pipeline/convert_hourly_city.py --array <that file> --columns "PM2.5,PM10,NO2,Ozone,AT,RH,WS,WD,NOx,era5:blh,skip,era5:u10,era5:v10,era5:sp,era5:tp" --first-hour 2023-01-01 --stations data_pipeline/stations/mumbai.csv --facts data_pipeline/stations/mumbai_facts.csv --out data/mumbai (docs/V2_PROGRESS.md step 10; rebuilt 2026-11-06: all 7 files identical).
